answer: What survives to the hollow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the orchard of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ivory re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, unlocked only after continuous uptime. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
